metadata.title: World Problems Backbone — Unified Data Spine
metadata.description: Unified data backbone for modeling and solving global problems (hunger, conflict, climate, economy). Each country is a row; all dimensions join by iso3.

alternatives.name: External Debt Renegotiation/Cancellation
alternatives.detail: Frees domestic budget for social programs

structural_blockers.name: Armed Conflict
structural_blockers.description: Active conflict zones where direct investment does not work without peace. Gaza, Sudan, South Sudan, Haiti, DRC, Somalia, Afghanistan.

structural_blockers.name: Climate Change
structural_blockers.description: Droughts, floods and extreme weather events devastating harvests, especially in sub-Saharan Africa.

structural_blockers.name: Corruption & Governance
structural_blockers.description: Resource diversion, captured elites, absence of rule of law.

structural_blockers.name: Restricted Access (Last Mile)
structural_blockers.description: Logistics impossible in besieged, isolated or non-state-controlled areas.

enrichments.scope: BRA deep-data: justice, energy, taxation, food_security + health/education/security/environment/employment field additions
enrichments.description: Brazil-specific deep data added. All other countries have null values for new fields, ready for future enrichment from OECD/World Bank/IEA sources.
